stops.note: men 'stone' + hir 'long'; the Carnac alignments in Brittany contain around 3,000 standing stones
adopted by French antiquarians; much later, from 1959, the Asterix comics made Obelix a menhir deliveryman
taken from French; the Grand Menhir Brisé at Locmariaquer, now broken in four, was over 20 metres long

current_meaning: a tall upright prehistoric standing stone
